shared_elements: carved/incised relief on a stone surface
human figure (depicted in A, embodied as a statue in B)
curved arched or banded line spanning the upper field
repeated small motifs arranged in rows/registers
justification: Both surfaces carry shallow incised carving in which discs/rings and a broad curving band across the upper field are the most legible motifs, and both organise smaller signs into loose horizontal rows. Otherwise they are quite different: A is a flat, crisply drawn pictorial scene of figures beneath a rayed disc packed with dense script, while B is an eroded three-dimensional stone block whose sparse, worn motifs are spread over a sculpted body with no narrative scene or script.
